### Recent Blogs
###  [ De-Risking Heavy Industry: How Skills Management Supports ISO 9001 Quality and Compliance ](https://kahunaworkforce.com/iso-9001-skills-management/)
See how ISO 9001 skills management helps heavy-industry leaders improve workforce competence, audit readiness, and operational quality and corrective action.
###  [ Your Competency Data Is a Safety Leading Indicator. Are You Using It Like One? ](https://kahunaworkforce.com/safety-leading-indicators-competency-data/)
Competency data is one of the most overlooked safety leading indicators in chemical manufacturing. Learn how HSE leaders can use workforce competency data to identify risk before it shows up in incident reports.
###  [ Closing the Quality Gap Between FTEs and Contractors Using Contractor Qualification Management ](https://kahunaworkforce.com/contractor-qualification-management-turnarounds/)
Stop turnaround rework before it starts. Learn how contractor qualification management bridges the quality gap between external labor and FTEs in manufacturing.
###  [ Why Manual Hospital Competency Tracking Is Fracturing Operations ](https://kahunaworkforce.com/manual-hospital-competency-tracking-fracturing-operations/)
Manual hospital competency tracking creates operational, staffing, and compliance risk. Learn why spreadsheets and checklists fall short as workforce complexity grows.
###  [ Workday and SAP SuccessFactors Track Training, But Who Tracks Plant Operator Qualification? ](https://kahunaworkforce.com/plant-operator-qualification-tracking/)
Workday and SAP SuccessFactors help manufacturers track training, but plant operator qualification tracking requires validated skills data tied to units, tasks, shifts, and real operating conditions.
###  [ How Competency Management Supports Magnet® Recognition in Health Systems ](https://kahunaworkforce.com/magnet-recognition-competency-management/)
Learn how Kahuna supports Magnet® recognition competency management with stronger workforce evidence across validations, certifications, clinical ladders, analytics, and redesignation.
